answer_1.quote: We build Planorama… to study if users' preferred plans… help them solve problems… We deploy LLM‑generated step‑by‑step plans to assist users in multi‑step math and trivia questions.

answer_2.quote: We log users' accuracy‑if they answer q correctly on their first try‑and execution time… we later combine these into a single score to label which plan … best helps users.

answer_3.quote: We also use GPT‑4o as a generative RM (LLM‑as‑a‑judge), predicting which plan would help a human user answer the question more accurately and quickly.

answer_4.quote: We have 126 English‑speaking users… collecting 4388 execution traces and 5584 preferences… users pick which plan they think will help them solve the question more accurately/quickly.
answer_4.guideline: Users compare two plans in pairwise comparisons and indicate which they believe will help them answer more accurately and quickly.
